response: A gradient gives the direction and rate of steepest increase of a function.
Fine-tuning updates a pretrained model using data for a target task.
A reward is feedback from an environment after an action.
A policy maps observations to actions or action probabilities.
Overfitting means fitting training data without generalizing well to unseen data.
LoRA trains low-rank weight updates while keeping the original weights frozen.
A batch is a group of examples processed together.
The learning rate controls the size of parameter updates.
